# TypeScript Fixes — Common Patterns

## Do NOT edit generated files

- `*.gen.ts` / `*.gen.tsx` — regenerated by `bun run predev` / `faststore generate`
- `manifest.gen.ts`, `invoke.gen.ts`, `meta.gen.ts` — always auto-generated
- If a gen file import breaks, the issue is in the source, not the gen file

## TS errors that don't break the build

`tsc --noEmit` errors that don't affect `npm run build` / `bun run build` are
**type debt**, not blockers. Severity "low" in triage — file as issues but never
critical/high.

## Common patterns after a port

```ts
// Missing type on event handler
const handler = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => { ... }

// Zod schema instead of JSDoc annotation (TanStack/deco)
export const schema = z.object({ title: z.string(), ... });

// Optional chaining for context that can be undefined during SSR
const price = product?.price ?? null;
```
